stem.text: A mass of $30\,\text{kg}$ is suspended from the end of a wire. A horizontal force $F$ acts on the mass so that it is in equilibrium, with the wire at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the vertical, as shown.

stem.alt: Mass hanging on a wire from a grey ceiling bar, with a dashed vertical line, the angle 30° marked between the wire and the vertical, a horizontal arrow labelled F acting on the mass, and the label mass 30 kg.
